identificationModule.briefTitle: Efficacy and Safety of RC28-E Versus Aflibercept
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Randomized, Double-Masked, Multicenter, Two-Arm Study Comparing the Efficacy and Safety of RC28-E 2mg Versus Aflibercept in Subjects With Wet Age-Related Macular Degeneration

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This is a randomized, double-masked, multicenter study comparing the the efficacy and safety of RC28-E injection (a chimric decoy receptor trap fusion protein by dual blockage of VEGF and FGF-2) versus aflibercept in patients with wet age-related macular degeneration.

armGroups.label: RC28-E
armGroups.description: RC28-E 2 mg will be initially injected 3 times at 4 week intervals, then each subject will be injected every 12 weeks unless there is disease activity. If disease activity is identified, the subject will be reassigned to receive injections every 8 weeks thereafter, up to study exit.

armGroups.label: Aflibercept
armGroups.description: Aflibercept 2 mg will be injected 3 times at 4 week intervals, followed by injections every 8 weeks.

interventions.name: RC28-E
interventions.description: Ophthalmic solution for intravitreal injection administered as a 2.0mg/50 µL dose.

interventions.name: Aflibercept
interventions.description: Ophthalmic solution for intravitreal injection administered as a 2.0mg/50 µL dose.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Mean change from baseline in BCVA at week 48;
primaryOutcomes.description: BCVA=Best-corrected visual acuity; Measurement of visual acuity with Early Treatment Diabetic Retinopathy Study (ETDRS) charts.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Average change in BCVA from baseline over the period week 36 through week 48;
secondaryOutcomes.description: For each subject, this endpoint is defined as the average of the changes from Baseline to Weeks 36, 40, 44 and 48.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of subjects with q12w injection;
Proportion of subjects with q12w injection at week 48 within the subjects with no q8w injection need at week 16, week 20;
secondaryOutcomes.description: for subjects randomized to RC28-E group only; q12w=every 12 weeks; q8w=every 8 weeks; A disease activity assessment (DAA) was performed at pre-specified visits (Weeks 16, 20, 28, 32, 40, 44) to identify q8w injection need.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of subjects with gain in BCVA of 15/10/5/0 letters or more from baseline to week 48;
secondaryOutcomes.description: Proportion of subjects; BCVA=Best-corrected visual acuity;

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Mean change in CST from baseline to week 16, week 48;
Average change in CST from baseline over the period week 36 through week 48;
Proportion of subjects with presence of intraretinal fluid/subretinal fluid at week 16, week 48;
secondaryOutcomes.description: Intraretinal fluid was assessed using SD-OCT and recorded as Present/Absent. Subretinal fluid was assessed using SD-OCT and recorded as Present/Absent. The presence of intraretinal fluid/subretinal fluid is an indicator of underlying disease.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Percentage of subjects with disease activity present at week 16;
secondaryOutcomes.description: A disease activity assessment (DAA) was performed to identify q8w injection need. 95% confidence interval (CI) for binomial proportions is based on Clopper-Pearson exact method. One eye (study eye) contributed to the analysis. Hypothesis testing not pre-specified.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in choroidal neovascularization (CNV) lesion size from baseline to week 12, week 48;
secondaryOutcomes.description: CNV lesion size (the area of new blood vessels in the choroid layer of the retina) was measured using fundus fluorescein angiography (FFA). A negative change value indicates a reduction in lesion size, whereas a positive change value indicates an increase. An increase in CNV lesion size may indicate progression of the underlying disease. Only one eye (study eye) contributed to the analysis.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Proportion of subjects with q8w treatment need at weeks 16, 20, 28, 32, 40, 44;
secondaryOutcomes.description: q8w=every 8 weeks; A disease activity assessment (DAA) was performed at pre-specified visits (Weeks 16, 20, 28, 32, 40, 44) to identify q8w need. This outcome measure was pre-specified for RC28-E arm only.

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Incidence and characteristics of ocular and systemic treatment emergent adverse events.
